subject: SIG initiation: Evoa Medical security questionnaire & hosting clarifications
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Tan <sarah.tan@evoamed.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Evoa follow-up: questionnaire choice + prefill asks

Hi Sarah —

Great to meet you and Liam earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and the asks we promised to follow up on so we can kick the vendor questionnaire work off:

1) Questionnaire type: would you prefer us to start with the SIG (Security and Trust) prefilling or the CAIQ? Either works on our side but SIG gives more granular controls for hosting/residency questions.

2) SOC 2: you mentioned an active Type II audit in progress. Can you confirm the expected issuance month and whether you have a SOC 2 bridge letter we can attach in the intake?

3) Data residency & PHI: please confirm whether any customer PHI will be processed/ stored in our hosted offering. If you need on-prem/VPC, call that out so we map evidence owners.

4) Encryption & KMS: who owns the KMS keys for the environment that will process Evoa data? (Evoa-managed, cloud-provider CMK, or Redwood-managed).

5) Evidence owners: if you can share two POCs for security and privacy (name + email) we will route evidence requests directly.

I've attached a short prefill template to speed things up; if you fill the shaded fields we can pre-populate most answers and reduce back-and-forth.

Next steps: if you send the prefill by EOD Wednesday we can kick the SIG/CAIQ work and propose a 30-minute evidence alignment call for next week.

Thanks —

Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Evoa_SIG_Prefill_Template.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: Sarah Tan <sarah.tan@evoamed.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@evoamed.com>, Jamal Ross <jamal.ross@evoamed.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evoa follow-up: questionnaire choice + prefill asks

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear recap. Answers below and a couple of clarifying notes:

• Questionnaire: SIG first, please. Our security team prefers the SIG mapping because it aligns with our internal control framework.
• SOC 2: we are in the middle of a Type II run; expected report delivery is late May 2027. We do have a security attestation memo for FY26 that I can attach now.
• PHI: yes — we will be sending limited PHI from our scheduling and claims pipelines. We need HIPAA safeguards verified (BAA).
• KMS: Evoa will manage keys in our AWS account (customer-managed CMKs). We will share the KMS key ARN and the key-owner contact.
• Evidence owners: Jamal Ross (security ops) — jamal.ross@evoamed.com; Liam O'Connor (privacy/compliance) — liam.oconnor@evoamed.com.

I've populated the prefill template with what I can (attached). Remaining fields are hosting specifics and log-retention windows that I left blank for you to confirm.

Attach: Evoa_SIG_Prefill_Template.xlsx

Happy to do the evidence alignment call next Tue 10–10:30am PT if that works for your team.

—Sarah
Head of IT Security, Evoa Medical
[Attachment: Evoa_SIG_Prefill_Template.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Tan <sarah.tan@evoamed.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 17:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evoa follow-up: questionnaire choice + prefill asks

Thanks Sarah — that's perfect and super helpful. A few quick clarifying questions so we scope evidence correctly: 

• BAA: we'll route that to Legal. Does Evoa require Redwood to sign a standard BAA or are you asking for a custom amendment?
• Log retention: for hosted customers our default is 90d application logs and 365d audit/trace logs. Does Evoa require different windows for either?
• KMS access model: with customer-managed CMKs we need a brief diagram of cross-account IAM roles that allow Redwood to perform envelope encryption (we don't require key rotation rights). Can Jamal share a diagram or ARN list?

Also looping Jordan (ps: our solutions architect) and Monica from support to confirm operational owners for the evidence call. Jordan, Monica — can you be on the Tue 10am PT slot if Sarah/Liam confirm?

I attached a draft SLA (internal version) to the thread so Evoa's procurement can have a look before the call.

Best,

Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_SLA_Draft_v1.docx (docx)]
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@evoamed.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Sarah Tan <sarah.tan@evoamed.com>
Cc: Jamal Ross <jamal.ross@evoamed.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 18:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evoa follow-up: questionnaire choice + prefill asks

Karthik/Sarah —

Tue 10am PT works for us. A couple notes ahead of the call so we can make the session actionable:

• BAA: Procurement prefers a standard Redwood BAA; if Redwood needs contract changes we'll flag those during the procurement review after the evidence call.
• Logs: Evoa needs 1 year for audit/trace logs (365d) and 180 days for application logs.
• KMS diagram: Jamal will send the cross-account role ARNs and a short diagram before EOD Tuesday.

We appreciate you sending the draft SLA — procurement will review and we can surface any redlines in the follow-up.

See you Tuesday.

—Liam O'Connor
Director, Product & Integrations, Evoa Medical
